sources.title: brucoder/winter · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Winter is a lightweight, open-source language model developed by Ineza Aime Bruno. Built for efficiency and performance, it provides a fast and accessible baseline for natural language processing tasks.

sources.title: brucoder/winter-frost-1-pro · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A larger follow‑up model, winter-frost-1-pro (~774M parameters, broader pretraining corpus via streaming), is trained under the same from‑scratch philosophy on the same free‑tier hardware.
